title: Two reasoning models join the text API
summary:
Two reasoning models arrived, model discovery got a clearer home, and generation responses became more accurate.

Kimi K2 Thinking and Gemini 3 Pro Preview were added with reasoning and tool use. Kimi accepts text; Gemini accepts text, images, audio, and video as input.

The gateway’s text and image model endpoints now return registry-backed listings with aliases, pricing, descriptions, and capabilities. The old backend `/models` endpoints return HTTP 410 and point to their replacements. The `openai` alias now maps to GPT-5 Nano, and `openai-large` maps to GPT-4.1.

Image responses now identify whether Turbo or Flux actually handled a request. Invalid model names and image parameters return HTTP 400; text errors have a structured response. Corrected upstream IDs for three text models, improved compatibility with Gemini’s finish reason, and added streaming-usage requests.

highlights.title: Kimi K2 Thinking
highlights.text: Use `kimi-k2-thinking` for text-based reasoning and tool use. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=kimi-k2-thinking).

highlights.title: Gemini 3 Pro Preview
highlights.text: Use `gemini-3-pro` for reasoning and tool use with text, image, audio, or video input. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gemini-3-pro).

highlights.title: Richer model listings
highlights.text: The gateway’s text and image model endpoints now return aliases, pricing, descriptions, and capability metadata from the model registry. [Explore the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
